response.justification: While the candidate brings relevant geospatial domain expertise through GIS platform work and demonstrates strong senior-level engineering practices, there is a critical gap in the primary technical requirement. The role explicitly requires modern C++ or Rust expertise—the candidate's C++ experience is over a decade old, primary recent work is in JavaScript/TypeScript, and there is no Rust experience. Recent career trajectory shows movement away from systems programming toward web and AI infrastructure, poorly positioning them for the technical demands of critical routing pipeline systems.
strengths: Relevant geospatial domain knowledge from GIS platform and mapping application development work
Demonstrated senior-level engineering capability with strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD) across multiple roles
Proven experience building distributed systems and low-latency backends handling real-time data at scale
concerns: Critical gap in modern C++ expertise—only 11-year-old experience from National Instruments; current work primarily in JavaScript/TypeScript
No Rust experience; Rust is listed as an acceptable alternative to C++ for this role's core requirements
Recent career trajectory (5+ years) focused on web platforms, AI/ML infrastructure, and developer tooling rather than systems programming
